div.div: خِرِّيجٌ has the meaning of a pass. part. n.: (S, K:) you say, هُوَ خِرِّيجُ فُلَانٍ (tropical:) He is, or has been, well educated or disciplined or trained by such a one (S, A, * K *) in polite accomplishments, (S, K,) or in science and art. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
